usedFor: Octoparse scrapes websites, and “Start a Task” runs a task in the cloud while “Stop a Task” halts it.

bestTemplate.name: “Start a Task” in Octoparse
bestTemplate.why: It starts a saved scraping task, so fresh data arrives without opening Octoparse.

watchOut: “Stop a Task” halts a running task, so keep it out of schedules that could cut a run short.
